text.description_html:
Acorn PS6YP, Rose Ceramic Cabinet Knob

The Rose Ceramic Cabinet Knob is hand painted. Just so, each one will have the unique touch of the artist--a true piece of art. Acorn made, the floral decorative knob will be sure to brighten up your home with its arty style by adding a unique and colorful touch to any cabinet or drawer. It measures 1-7/8" squared. The Floral Ceramic Knob are available in 3 colors: light blue, dark blue, and yellow.

Features of the Rose Ceramic Cabinet Knob:

  • Length: 1-7/8" squared
  • Material: ceramic
  • Each design is hand painted on ceramic.
  • Package includes 1 knob and hardware for installation.

Sold Individually. Due to the hand painted nature of this product, the colors will vary slightly.
